items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: Interviewer asks 'Where is she from, Philadelphia?' and Interviewee responds 'She's from Forest City, Arkansas.'

ctx.x: And you never got out your old banjo in March.
Do you know Amy Sharp did not know what the Mummers were? We had to explain it. In fact, she thought we were putting her on for the longest time. Where is she from, Philadelphia?
